decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at C590-09 (16.5 g/t, 260 t, about 138 oz). Radio and CMMS agree, and the likely repair is 13:20. LH-08 is on an infrastructure heading worth 0.4 oz/h, and it can reach the stope in 0.48 h. As an LH410 it loads about 30 t/h, which is about 16 oz/h at this grade, so the loan clearly pays. I did not take LH-09 because its heading is on the critical path (5.7 oz/h). LH-10 is free from 10:00 but would arrive about 10:20 and add little. Central is slightly truck-limited. Its stockpile has 153 t of headroom, and the higher-grade ore displaces lower-grade ore, so the net gain is still positive. Gain is a rough estimate.

Keep LH-08 (cheap 0.4 oz/h infrastructure loan) on the 16.5 gpt stope C590-09, since LH-01 is out until about 13:20 or later. Send idle LH-10 (free at 10:00, 0.31 h away) to C564-08, which has 223 t at 9 gpt and no loader because LH-02 is down until 15:00 to 17:00. LH-10 loads about 25 t/h, so about 6.7 h gives roughly 170 t, or about 49 oz of stope ore. Central stockpile has 123 t of room and trucks move 91 t/h, so truck and stockpile limits cut the real gain to about 30 oz. No reserve activation, because no stope was stopped. Taking LH-09 (critical path, 5.7 oz/h) is not worth it.
